US.summary:
* **Natera, Inc. (NTRA)** - Executives reported multiple insider stock sales to satisfy tax withholding obligations.
* **uniQure N.V. (QURE)** - Posted a Q2 revenue beat, received an upgrade to Outperform from Wolfe Research, and saw shares rise 7.9%.
* **Rocket Lab Corporation (RKLB)** - Shares fell 8.3% as ARK Investment added shares and analysts flagged potential undervaluation following its recent Space Force contract.
* **Meta Platforms, Inc. (META)** - Reported strong Q2 revenue but missed EPS estimates due to heavy AI spending, sending shares tumbling in after-hours trading.
* **iShares Gold Trust (IAU)** - Traded within a volatile range as gold prices reacted to the Fed's rate decision and June PCE inflation data.
* **Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (HIMS)** - Shares dropped 12%–15% after the FTC and state regulators filed a lawsuit alleging unauthorized patient data sharing.
* **ZS** - Partnered with Schwarz Digits to deliver a sovereign Zero Trust SASE service in Germany amid notable institutional ownership shifts.
* **BioNTech SE (BNTX)** - Secured European Commission marketing authorization for its 2026-2027 XFG-adapted COVID-19 vaccine.
* **Johnson & Johnson (JNJ)** - Completed the $1 billion acquisition of Firefly Bio while trimming its FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance due to deal costs.
* **ORCL** - S&P Global downgraded the stock to BBB- (its lowest investment grade) amid surging debt and heavy AI capital expenditure concerns.
* **ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd. (ASX)** - Shares dropped 8.3% as short interest fell sharply ahead of its Q2 earnings release.
* **Qnity Electronics, Inc. (Q)** - Announced it is joining imec's research program to advance semiconductor packaging technologies.
* **KIOXIA HLDGS CORP (KXIAY)** - ADR prices dropped over 14% over the last 24 hours ahead of its Q1 FY2026 earnings release.
* **Robo Global Robotics and Automation Index ETF (ROBO)** - Sector sentiment was pressured by a newly announced FCC ban on foreign-manufactured advanced robots and connected power inverters.
* **Sandisk Corporation (SNDK)** - Experienced a 7.3% stock decline amid heightened options volatility and increased institutional buying.
* **Repligen Corporation (RGEN)** - Received a price target increase to $175 from JPMorgan alongside a maintained overweight rating.

INDIA.summary:
* **LAURUSLABS** - Shares hit a new high of ₹1,798, extending a 97% rally from February lows.
* **MTAR Technologies Limited (MTARTECH)** - Reported record Q1 FY27 results with revenue surging 130.4% YoY to ₹360.7 crore and PAT jumping 364.5% YoY to ₹50.2 crore.
* **GRAVITA** - Stock declined ~8% post-Q1 FY27 earnings despite a 29% YoY rise in adjusted EBITDA; subsidiary Gravita Metal Inc. operations scheduled to close on August 1.
* **Saregama India Limited (SAREGAMA)** - Share price reached a fresh 52-week high of ₹535.8.
* **KMEW** - Stock rallied 9% to an all-time high of ₹2,735.50 following a breakout buy recommendation.
* **AYE FINANCE LIMITED (AYE)** - Successfully allotted 22,000 non-convertible debentures (NCDs) worth ₹220 crore.
* **EPACKPEB** - Stock surged 7.23% in a single session to a day high of ₹271.75 ahead of its upcoming Q1 earnings call.
* **DSSL** - Secured a major ₹268 crore contract from the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) for data centre infrastructure, boosting shares by ~3.9%.
* **MAMATA MACHINERY LIMITED (MAMATA)** - Released Q1 results reporting revenue of ₹73.75 crore and net profit of ₹0.01 crore.
* **NEOGEN** - Highlighted a Q1 FY27 earnings beat with a 69% EPS beat, driving upwardly revised forecasts and a price target increase to ₹2,167.
